ops.text: 10.3 Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement or any Order Form for any reason, Vendor shall (a) at Customer's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six (6) months at Vendor's then-current rates; (b) within thirty (30) days of Customer's request, return or make available for export all Customer Data in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (c) thereafter delete Customer Data from its systems, subject to routine backups and legal retention requirements, and certify such deletion in writing.

input.comment: [Playbook] We have added a transition-assistance and data-return provision, as Section 10 currently ends Customer's access without any obligation to help us migrate or to give our data back. Our playbook position is up to six months of assistance at Vendor's then-current rates, export of Customer Data in a machine-readable format within 30 days, and certified deletion thereafter; we can accept 90 days of assistance as a fallback.
input.summary: Insert Section 10.3 requiring transition assistance, Customer Data return in machine-readable format within 30 days, and certified deletion.
